_comment: Changes to master data tables, applied by tools/build-server-data.py. Keys are table names from the asset context (a.json). A rule either sets fields on every row matching 'match' ({"match": ..., "set": ...}) or removes those rows ({"match": ..., "remove": true}; an empty match removes all rows). A list as a match value means 'any of these'. Changed tables get their version bumped, so installed games re-download them.

AttendanceManagementData._why: Row 2 runs the daily play time event (playtimeAttendanceCode 1, until 2099), as in SSOMG: rewards for 5-60 minutes of play per day, reset at midnight. Hidden offline (daily reset, the play time is counted on the phone); a missing code means 'no event'.

StoreMenuData._why: Store home (0), recommended/real-money packages (101-103), diamonds (3000), headphones (3002), My Store (6000), inventory expansion (9000; the inventory size is set by the server, progression.json), pop-up shop (10000). Kept: card packs (2000/2001), RP exchange (3001), lobby wallpapers (7000/7001), artist packs (8000); the special store tabs (4000-4003) are locked in the table already. A store type without a tab opens the card packs (libil2cpp store-missing-tab-no-crash, store-fallback-card-packs-*).

LiveThemeData._why: LOONA's only live theme is a leftover copy of SUPERSTAR OH MY GIRL's 'Fresher Edition' (OH MY GIRL members, files on SSOMG's CDN).
